name: Houkago ni Midareru Ane Kyoushi to Tonari no Heya de Aegu Imouto ~Koibito ni Natta Onna no Ko ga, Shiriai no Iya na Otoko ni Netorareru~
original_name: 放課後に乱れる姉教師と隣の部屋で喘ぐ妹 ～ 恋人になった女の子が、知り合いの嫌な男に寝取られる ～
source:
The protagonist, Hirose Yuzuru, was an ordinary student. 
He studied and worked on his part time job like everyone else, and was content with his monotonous life.
But there was just one thing he wished to change.
He wanted to get closer with Aizawa Haruka, the woman he fell in love with from the time he enrolled in school.
“Getting into a relationship with her, a teacher, is an impossible dream,” he thought to himself resignedly.
So he continued his unchanging everyday life along with his classmate cum Haruka’s sister, Aizawa Yuuka; and the junior at his part time job, Usami Akari.

However, one day his father started talking about remarriage and his monotonous life completely changed. He started living together with the woman he yearned for, and his relationship with Yuuka (who also started living with him) and Akari began to change too.

Yuzuru looked towards his new circumstances with hope and anticipation…
but the worst possible outcome was the only thing waiting for him.
translation:
主角广濑结弦是一名普通的学生。
他和其他人一样一边学习一边打工，对单调的生活感到满足。
但他只想改变一件事。
他想和相泽遥更亲近，这个他从入学时就爱上的女人。
“和她这个老师建立关系，简直就是一个不可能实现的梦想。”他无奈地自言自语道。
于是，他和同学兼遥的妹妹相泽优香一起，继续着一成不变的日常生活。还有打工的后辈宇佐见明里。

然而有一天，父亲开始谈论再婚，他单调的生活彻底改变了。他开始与他渴望的女人同居，他与优花（也开始与他同居）和明里的关系也开始发生变化。

结弦满怀希望和期待地看着自己的新环境……
但等待他的只有最坏的结果。
